    <h2>{`About this task`}</h2>
    <p>{`In Graphite applications, there are often scenarios where you need to make certain fields read-only based on business rules, user permissions, or workflow states. This guide presents common scenarios for making fields read-only and provides step-by-step implementation instructions for each approach.`}</p>
    <h2>{`Scenarios and Implementation`}</h2>
    <h3>{`Scenario 1: Always Read-Only Fields`}</h3>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`When to use:`}</strong>{` Use this approach when a field should always be displayed as read-only for all users in all contexts.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Application behavior:`}</strong>{` The field will be visible but not editable under any circumstances. Users can see the value but cannot modify it.`}</p>
    <h4>{`Implementation Steps:`}</h4>
    <ol>
      <li parentName="ol">{`Open your page XML file`}</li>
      <li parentName="ol">{`Add the `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`readonly="true"`}</inlineCode>{` attribute to the field component`}</li>
      <li parentName="ol">{`Save and deploy your changes`}</li>
    </ol>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Example:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<text-input id="wonum" label="Work Order" value="{item.wonum}" readonly="true" />
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Scenario 2: Status-Based Read-Only Fields`}</h3>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`When to use:`}</strong>{` Use this approach when fields should become read-only based on the status of the record (e.g., making all fields read-only when a work order is completed).`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Application behavior:`}</strong>{` Fields will be editable when the record is in certain statuses and become read-only when the status changes to a specified value.`}</p>
    <h4>{`Implementation Steps:`}</h4>
    <ol>
      <li parentName="ol">{`Open your page XML file`}</li>
      <li parentName="ol">{`Add a conditional expression to the `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`readonly`}</inlineCode>{` attribute that checks the status`}</li>
      <li parentName="ol">{`Save and deploy your changes`}</li>
    </ol>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Example:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<text-input id="description" label="Description" value="{item.description}" 
            readonly="{item.status === 'COMPLETED' || item.status === 'CLOSED'}" />
`}</code></pre>
    <p>{`For multiple fields affected by the same status condition:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`/**
 * Set fields as read-only based on status
 * @param {Object} page - The page object
 * @param {Object} item - The current record
 */
setStatusBasedReadOnly(page, item) {
  const isReadOnly = ['COMPLETED', 'CLOSED'].includes(item.status);
  
  // Get references to field components
  const descriptionField = page.findWidget('descriptionField');
  const priorityField = page.findWidget('priorityField');
  const locationField = page.findWidget('locationField');
  
  // Apply read-only state
  if (descriptionField) descriptionField.readonly = isReadOnly;
  if (priorityField) priorityField.readonly = isReadOnly;
  if (locationField) locationField.readonly = isReadOnly;
}
`}</code></pre>
    <p>{`Call this method when the page initializes and when the status changes:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`/**
 * Handle status change
 * @param {string} newStatus - The new status value
 */
handleStatusChange(newStatus) {
  const currentItem = this.page.datasources.workorderds.currentItem;
  if (currentItem) {
    this.setStatusBasedReadOnly(this.page, currentItem);
  }
}
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Scenario 3: Dependent Field Relationships`}</h3>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`When to use:`}</strong>{` Use this approach when the editability of one field depends on the value of another field (e.g., making Location read-only when an Asset is selected).`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Application behavior:`}</strong>{` When the user selects or enters a value in one field, related fields will automatically become read-only or editable based on the defined relationship.`}</p>
    <h4>{`Implementation Steps:`}</h4>
    <ol>
      <li parentName="ol">{`Create a controller method to determine the read-only state`}</li>
      <li parentName="ol">{`Bind the field’s `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`readonly`}</inlineCode>{` attribute to this method`}</li>
      <li parentName="ol">{`Set up event listeners to update the state when dependent fields change`}</li>
    </ol>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Example:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<text-input id="locationField" label="Location" value="{item.location}"

`}</code></pre>

    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{

`}</code></pre>

   * @param {Object} page - The page object

  }
  
  /**
   * Set fields as read-only based on status (Scenario 2)
   * @param {Object} page - The page object

   */
  setStatusBasedReadOnly(page, item) {
    const isReadOnly = ['COMPLETED', 'CLOSED'].includes(item.status);
    
    // Get references to field components
    const descriptionField = page.findWidget('descriptionField');

    <h2>{`Best Practices and Considerations`}</h2>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Visual Feedback`}</strong>{`: Provide clear visual indication that fields are read-only to improve user experience.`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Error Messages`}</strong>{`: Display helpful messages explaining why fields cannot be edited when applicable.`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Performance`}</strong>{`: Minimize the number of DOM manipulations when changing readonly states dynamically.`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Server-Side Validation`}</strong>{`: Always implement server-side validation as well, since client-side readonly attributes can be bypassed.`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Consistency`}</strong>{`: Apply read-only rules consistently across similar fields and pages.`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Testing`}</strong>{`: Test read-only behavior across different user roles and scenarios.`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Accessibility`}</strong>{`: Ensure read-only fields meet accessibility standards with proper ARIA attributes.`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Mobile Considerations`}</strong>{`: Test read-only behavior on mobile devices where touch interactions differ.`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Documentation`}</strong>{`: Document the business rules that determine when fields should be read-only.`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Graceful Degradation`}</strong>{`: Ensure your application works correctly even if JavaScript is disabled or errors occur.`}</li>
